# KenjiAI

> KenjiAI is an AI business automation platform for small and mid-market business owners. It replaces 17+ marketing and sales tools with one AI-driven stack: voice agents, CRM, funnels, email and SMS automation, ads management, and free AI tools.

Founder: Yousif Alias. Companies: KenjiAI (AI automation platform) and Media Traffics (paid acquisition agency). Pricing: monthly $375 + 10% performance fee, annual $270/mo + 5% performance fee, lifetime by application. 30-day money-back guarantee.

## Core pages

- [Pricing](https://kenjiai.com/pricing): plan comparison, performance-fee explanation, FAQs, 30-day guarantee
- [Overview](https://kenjiai.com/overview): exclusive briefing video and onboarding CTAs
- [Free AI Tools](https://kenjiai.com/free-tools): catalog of free tools (Prompt Generator, PR Pro, Sales Coach AI, more)
- [Voice AI](https://kenjiai.com/voice-ai): AI voice agents for inbound and outbound calls
- [Marketing Automation](https://kenjiai.com/marketing-automation): email, SMS, funnels, workflows
- [CRM](https://kenjiai.com/crm): pipelines, contacts, automations
- [Knowledge Base](https://kenjiai.com/knowledge): articles on AI for business, marketing, sales
- [Blog](https://kenjiai.com/blog): industry news, tutorials, founder essays

## Free tools (separate subdomains)

- [AI Prompt Generator](https://prompt.kenjiai.com): generate optimized AI prompts for any use case
- [PR Pro](https://prpro.kenjiai.com): AI-powered PR campaigns and media outreach drafts
- [Sales Coach AI](https://salescoach.kenjiai.com): AI sales trainer and roleplay partner
